caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic bowl shown from two perspectives: a top-down view and a side profile view. The bowl is round and shallow with a slightly flared rim and is predominantly reddish-brown in color. Along the inner rim are small, evenly spaced indents creating a decorative edge. On the inside surface, there are painted designs in a lighter yellowish or ochre color; these consist of three wavy horizontal lines near the top and bottom, and a central motif resembling three sharp, looping peaks with parallel details inside each peak segment. The side profile view at the bottom of the image shows the bowl’s gentle curvature and the same reddish-brown color, as well as the texture and thickness of the bowl. The background is plain and off-white.
title: Pie Plate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
